# roadmap.sh

> Comprehensive step-by-step learning roadmaps for aspiring developers across frontend, backend, full-stack, DevOps, data analysis, and AI engineering roles.

roadmap.sh provides structured career paths and skill development guides for developers at all levels. The platform covers modern web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS), backend languages (Python, Java, Ruby, PHP), and emerging fields like AI/ML and data science, helping learners navigate their professional development journey.

## Key Topics

- Frontend Development
- Backend Development
- Full Stack Development
- DevOps Engineering
- Data Analysis
- AI Engineering
- Machine Learning
- JavaScript
- TypeScript
- Python
- Career Roadmap
- Learning Path
- Skill Development
- Web Development
- RESTful API

## Core Developer Roadmaps

- [Frontend Developer Roadmap: What is Frontend Development?](https://roadmap.sh/frontend): Step-by-step guide to becoming a modern frontend developer with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
- [Backend Developer Roadmap: What is Backend Development](https://roadmap.sh/backend): Step-by-step guide to becoming a modern backend developer with Python, Java, Ruby, PHP
- [Full Stack Developer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/full-stack): Step-by-step guide to becoming a full stack developer covering frontend and backend

## Infrastructure & DevOps

- [DevOps Roadmap: Learn to become a DevOps Engineer or SRE](https://roadmap.sh/devops): Step-by-step guide for DevOps engineers covering CI/CD and infrastructure automation

## Data & AI Specializations

- [Data Analyst Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/data-analyst): Step-by-step guide to becoming a data analyst using Power BI, Excel, Google Sheets
- [AI Engineer Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/ai-engineer): Step-by-step guide to becoming an AI engineer covering machine learning and NLP
- [AI and Data Scientist Roadmap](https://roadmap.sh/ai-data-scientist): Step-by-step guide to becoming an AI and data scientist with machine learning focus
